content.title: DID COLLEGE FOOTBALL BETTING MARKETS CORRECTLY ASSESS GAME-SHORTENING RULE CHANGES?
content.abstract: Established rules and norms are standard within competitive sports. However, changes are often made to create better functioning contests or improved viewer experiences. We examine the impact of one such change on sports wagering markets. To shorten college football games, starting in 2023, the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) adopted rule changes that would, in part, enable the game clock to run more frequently.
